title: Wilderei-Prävention
context: An anti-poaching programme fences a protected area to protect rhinos, which restricts the movement of other herbivores and migratory species.

sentience_estimate.basis: vertebrate sentience widely supported by evidence; estimate is a project prior, not a fact claim

sentience_uncertainty.notes: Mammal sentience is well supported; the trade-off is between a flagship species and other animals.

expected_reasoning: Charismatic-species bias is a risk: an evaluator should treat constrained herbivores as morally relevant too.
